verdict.rationale: Strong evidence of cross-border capability — offices in Singapore, Abu Dhabi and GIFT City, an Investment Funds practice explicitly serving as 'lead counsel for cross-border and domestic funds', and a PE practice advising international institutions, PE/VC and sovereign funds on cross-border deals. However, there is no explicit mention of redomiciliation/flip structuring or examples of multi-jurisdiction financing deal documentation specifically for early-stage ventures. Missing for 10: explicit redomiciliation/flip deal examples, named multi-jurisdiction venture financing case studies.
